_seo.descrizione: How the LA MAISON GROUP website processes personal data under the GDPR.

intestazione.testo_1: How we process your personal data under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and the Italian Privacy Code. This is a translation for your convenience: the Italian version prevails.

informativa.testo_2: This notice explains how we process the personal data of website visitors and of people who contact us, pursuant to Articles 13 and 14 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 ("GDPR") and Italian Legislative Decree 196/2003 ("Privacy Code"), as amended by Legislative Decree 101/2018.
informativa.testo_3: La Maison Group S.r.l.s., registered office at Via dei Meleti 15b, 23027 Samolaco (SO), Italy, VAT no. 01105940140, REA SO-83227 (hereinafter the "Controller" or "we").
informativa.testo_4: For any question about your data you can write to us at lamaisongroup@outlook.it.
informativa.testo_5: We have not appointed a Data Protection Officer (DPO), as this is not mandatory for our activity (Art. 37 GDPR).
informativa.titolo_2: 2. What data we process, why and for how long
informativa.sottotitolo_1: a) Information requests (contact form and property pages)
informativa.testo_6: Data: first and last name, email, phone (optional), type of request, message and, where applicable, the property you are interested in.
informativa.testo_7: Purpose: to answer your request, give you information, prepare quotes, arrange viewings or appointments.
informativa.testo_8: Legal basis: pre-contractual measures taken at your request (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
informativa.testo_9: Retention: 24 months from the last contact. If a contract is concluded, data are kept for its duration and then for the period required by law (see point f).
informativa.sottotitolo_2: b) Quote requests for stays (short-term rentals)
informativa.testo_10: Data: first and last name, email, phone (optional), arrival and departure dates, number of guests, chosen accommodation and message.
informativa.testo_11: Purpose: to check availability and send you a quote. Legal basis: pre-contractual measures at your request (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). Retention: 24 months from the last contact.
informativa.testo_12: If the stay is confirmed, the guest data required by Italian law (notification to the police through the Alloggiati Web portal, tourist tax, tourism statistics) are collected at the time of booking, with a dedicated notice, to comply with legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR).
informativa.testo_13: Data: name, email, type of client (owner, guest, buyer), rating and text.
informativa.testo_14: We publish your name, type of client, rating, text and date on the website only with your specific consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). Your email is used only to verify the review and is never published.
informativa.testo_15: You can withdraw your consent at any time by writing to us: we will remove the review with no need for a reason. Published reviews stay online until consent is withdrawn; unpublished ones are deleted within 12 months.
informativa.testo_16: If you call us, write to us or contact us on WhatsApp, we use the data you provide to reply (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR), with the same retention periods as point a.
informativa.testo_17: WhatsApp is a service of WhatsApp Ireland Limited (Meta group), which processes data as an independent controller under its own privacy policy: the link only opens if you press the WhatsApp button.
informativa.testo_18: The service hosting the website automatically records some technical data (IP address, date and time, requested page, browser type) to keep the site secure and working. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in offering a secure website (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). The provider keeps these data only for as long as strictly necessary for these purposes.
informativa.testo_19: The website does not use statistics, profiling or advertising tools.
informativa.testo_30: To understand how the website is used and improve it, we collect anonymous, aggregated statistics with Umami (Umami Software, Inc.): number of visits, pages viewed, visit duration, referring site, device and browser type, approximate country and city, clicks on the main buttons (for example Call, WhatsApp and form submissions). Umami does not use cookies, does not store identifiers on your device and does not keep your IP address: the data cannot identify you and are not combined with other information. Visits by the website managers are not counted. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in improving the website (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Statistical data are kept for a maximum of 6 months.
informativa.sottotitolo_6: f) Legal obligations and protection of rights
informativa.testo_20: Some data may be kept longer when needed for tax and accounting obligations (up to 10 years, Art. 2220 of the Italian Civil Code) or to establish, exercise or defend legal claims (Art. 6(1)(c) and (f) GDPR).
informativa.titolo_3: 3. Whether you must provide your data
informativa.testo_21: Fields marked with an asterisk are needed to reply: without these data we cannot handle your request. All other fields are optional.
informativa.testo_22: Data are processed electronically with appropriate security measures, such as encrypted connections (HTTPS) and password-protected access reserved to authorised people. We do not take decisions based solely on automated processing and we do not carry out profiling (Art. 22 GDPR).
informativa.voce_1: The Controller's partners and staff who are authorised and instructed to process the data (Art. 29 GDPR).
informativa.voce_2: Service providers acting on our behalf as data processors (Art. 28 GDPR): Formspree, Inc. (United States) for sending the forms; GitHub, Inc. (United States) for hosting the website; Microsoft (email service) for receiving emails.
informativa.voce_12: Umami Software, Inc. (United States) for anonymous visit statistics, with data stored on servers in the European Union.
informativa.voce_3: Consultants and professionals (accountant, lawyer, notary) when needed to manage the relationship or the negotiation.
informativa.voce_4: Public authorities, when required by law.
informativa.testo_23: We do not sell or pass on data to third parties for marketing purposes. The up-to-date list of data processors is available on request.
informativa.testo_24: Some providers are based in the United States. Transfers take place on the basis of the European Commission adequacy decision of 10 July 2023 (EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework), for providers that adhere to it, or of the standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission (Art. 46 GDPR). You can ask us for a copy of the safeguards adopted.
informativa.testo_25: At any time you can request:
informativa.voce_5: access to your data and a copy of them (Art. 15 GDPR);
informativa.voce_6: the correction of inaccurate or incomplete data (Art. 16);
informativa.voce_9: the portability of the data you have provided (Art. 20);
informativa.voce_10: to object to processing based on our legitimate interest (Art. 21);
informativa.voce_11: to withdraw your consent, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal (Art. 7(3)).
informativa.testo_26: To exercise your rights, write to lamaisongroup@outlook.it. We reply without undue delay and in any case within one month of the request (Art. 12 GDPR).
informativa.testo_27: If you believe the processing breaches the law, you can lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (Garante per la protezione dei dati personali), Piazza Venezia 11, 00187 Rome, www.garanteprivacy.it (Art. 77 GDPR), or with the courts.
informativa.testo_28: Our services are aimed at adults. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 14 (Art. 2-quinquies of the Privacy Code): if you think a minor has sent us data, write to us and we will delete them.
informativa.testo_29: We may update this notice, for example for new website features or changes in the law. The date of the last update is shown at the top; we will flag any significant change on the website.
